noise: Set12 + BSD68, sigma 25 (the manifest's), test_noise seed 0 (as int_eval)
count_rule: window = max(ceil(K/W)+1, ceil(COUT/16)*max(1, max_b nnz_b), COUT), summed over conv1-conv10 (denoise/predict_w4.window_cycles, sparse); fill and drain left out
saving: 100 * (Original - layout) / Original of the count; pooled = over the summed counts of the images
how: every layout's windows come from the host emulation of its own export on every image; the column-permutation check below compares them with the Original's windows permuted by the export's permutation_manifest.json
